Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating the use of bicycles with occupied baby carriers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of bicycles with occupied baby carriers;and adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person shall not operate a bicycle attached to an occupied babycarrier on a street or other roadway, unless the bicycle is operatedwithin a city or town that prohibits the operation of bicycles on thesidewalk adjacent to the street or other roadway.
